title: { introducing }
blurb: A dawn haze and a half-finished thought: end-to-end tests you never write, or remember to run. On the blur the braces part and dots slide in to frame { intro▢▢▢ducing }, which flickers three stamps of the product in its gap and closes into the Replay mark and Replay QA.

shots.setting: an abstract studio haze, no place; 2026; dawn light (lilac → peach, a rose glow low in frame)

lines.text: Imagine end-to-end tests you never write. Or remember to run.
lines.direction: an invitation, warm and close; 'end-to-end' said plainly as one easy word, then a small lift and a breath on 'write', then let 'Or remember to run' land easy, almost a smile

shots.visual: The reference's opening frame without its figure. Kit haze preset 'dawn' fills the stage (lilac at the top falling to peach, a rose glow breathing upward from y0 ≈ 0.75, drift slow), four or five kit hairlines drifting horizontally across the frame at different speeds, light grain. Nothing else for the first half second: the haze breathes up and brightens (u 0.2 → 0.6). Then kit kinetic carries L0101 word by word, each word blurring in on the narrator's word time (0.1 s early), centred at x 640, y ≈ 288 (40 % height), Promo Sans light, size ≈ 40, white on the haze, slightly tight tracking, two lines at this size, breaking after 'write.' (line one 'Imagine end-to-end tests you never write.', line two 'Or remember to run.'; each line inside 1100 px). On 'remember' the kinetic grad sweep starts on the tail: 'Or remember to run.' runs white → peach → orange, the sweep finishing as 'run' lands. Hold the full line ≈ 1.0 s after the last word (it has been read as it was spoken), the hairlines still drifting and the rose glow cresting into the blur dissolve to ch01-s03. No product, no logo, no cursor.

lines.direction: confident, unhurried; a short, real pause after 'Introducing', then the name said plainly with pride, not announced

shots.visual: The reference's '{ introducing }' card. A blur dissolve from ch01-s01's haze lands on kit paper (the brace device of the cut '{ on their own }' card folds in here). At 0 s four kit squareDots sit wide at the corners of an invisible box (≈ 620 × 170 px, centred) around a bare pair of braces '{   }'; at 0.05 s the braces part (kit bracket u 0 → 1 over 0.45 s, ease-out) and '{ introducing }' blurs in inside them, while the four dots slide inward (dots 'wide' → 'corners') and stop at the brace corners on the M1 swell's crest. The card is fully there ≈ 0.1 s before the voice (≈ 0.5 s of type and music before 'Introducing'; the voice then says the word the eye is reading). Centred at y ≈ 330, Promo Sans light ≈ 46 px: '{ intro' set solid, 'ducing }' (the braces are the kit bracket glyphs; the word to read is 'introducing'). DIRECTOR'S NOTE (2026-10-14): NO product stills, stamps or screenshots inside or around the word: type, braces and dots only. On 'Replay' the gap closes (the halves slide together), the braces close in on the word, and the type cross-dissolves (blur, 0.3 s) into the Replay mark (kit replayMark, h ≈ 56) with 'Replay QA' beside it in Promo Sans regular ≈ 44 px: the lock-up is legible from mid-dissolve, as the voice says 'Replay', and fully landed on 'QA'. The four corner dots hold around the lock-up. Hold ≈ 0.7 s on the lock-up (it has been legible since mid-dissolve on Replay), then the film's one whip out to ch02.
